citations.citation: for the invention and realisation of optical lattice clocks, trapping neutral atoms at a magic wavelength to bring optical frequency standards to the 10^-18 level

For the invention and realization of optical lattice clocks, in which neutral atoms trapped at a magic wavelength reach fractional uncertainties near 1e-18

For the invention and realization of optical lattice clocks, in which neutral atoms trapped at a magic wavelength brought optical frequency standards to the 10^-18 level of fractional uncertainty
